clearance.grid.summary: Clearance/interference audit over instance or pair sets with include/exclude, expected contacts carrying a cause and allowed range, optional broad-phase pruning, optional Cartesian joint ranges and an explicit sample x pair budget. Joint sampling moves live joint positions and restores/readbacks them.

inputs.pairs: Either an array of {a,b} solid-body refs, or instances (below).
inputs.instances: Either an array of at least two occurrence/body refs; all unordered pairs are generated.
inputs.include: Optional array of pair ids to keep.
inputs.exclude: Optional array of pair ids to drop.
inputs.expectedContacts: Optional array of {a,b,cause,clearance:{min,max}}; these carry a reason and allowed range and are never deleted wholesale.
inputs.joints: Optional array of {joint, rotation?|slide?:{from,to}} Cartesian ranges; sampled as a product, not a synchronous diagonal.
inputs.budget: Optional {maxChecks}; the sample x pair product above the budget is reported without testing.
inputs.broadPhase: Optional boolean; prune non-overlapping instance AABBs via measure.bounds. Rejected before any pair measurement when joints are sampled or evaluated minimum is positive.
inputs.tolerance: Optional tolerance for expected-contact range comparison.

limitations: Unsigned distance is not penetration depth; a failed Boolean is not an empty intersection.
Coverage is sampled; dense grids do not prove continuous no-collision.
Joint sampling moves live joint positions and restores/readbacks each original value; restore failure is reported, not silently accepted.
broadPhase is rejected before measurements when joints are sampled or evaluated minimum is positive; the current AABB prune is not proven safe for those cases.

motion.envelope.summary: Compute a motion envelope for a moving body over a translation or rotation range: sampled envelope, conservative bounded envelope, and (only with an explicit certifiedPath coverage proof) a certified path.

inputs.motion: Required {type:translation|rotation, axis?, from, to}. translation uses length expressions along the axis; rotation uses angle expressions about the axis.
inputs.moving: Optional body/occurrence ref; mutually exclusive with explicit bounds.
inputs.certifiedPath: Optional coverage proof for certified representation; without it continuousVerified stays false.

limitations: Sampled and conservative envelopes bound the swept AABB, not a collision certificate.
Continuous no-collision requires the certified path coverage proof; a dense grid or sum of sampled bodies does not suffice.
